intent: 生成约 6 秒横屏短片：雨夜东京涩谷十字路口，霓虹反射在湿沥青上，人群撑伞匆匆而过，一辆红色双层巴士缓慢穿过画面，电影感 live-action，浅景深，环境音为主，无对白。
local:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a low-angle shot frames the wet asphalt of a Shibuya crossing in Tokyo on a rainy night. The camera remains close to the ground, focusing on the texture of the puddles reflecting blurred, colorful neon lights. A large red double-decker bus slowly passes through the mid-ground, its metallic surface catching the flickering neon reflections. Dense rain streaks appear silver under the lights, while blurred pedestrians with various umbrellas pass through the foreground, creating dynamic occlusions. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera pans and tilts up smoothly, transitioning from the narrow street view to the expansive Shibuya crossing. The red bus exits the frame, revealing the full intersection where giant, vibrant billboards cast light onto the wet ground, creating a flowing sea of color. Pedestrians with umbrellas move across the zebra crossing as rain splashes against the pavement.

overall_soundscape: Steady, immersive rain taps against umbrellas and the asphalt, accompanied by the low, heavy sound of bus tires rolling through puddles. Distant train whistles and faint, static-like city ambient noise layer underneath.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, atmospheric electronic drone with deep, resonant bass pulses that gradually swell in intensity before fading out.
official:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, a medium-wide shot captured from a low angle, with the camera executing a slow push-in. The scene is set at the iconic Tokyo Shibuya crossing on a dark, rainy night. A shallow depth of field keeps the midground sharply in focus while heavily blurring the extreme foreground and background into soft bokeh. The wet asphalt street is highly reflective, serving as a dark canvas that mirrors the vibrant neon pink, cyan, and yellow glowing signs from the surrounding towering buildings. A dense crowd of anonymous pedestrians hurries across the intersection in multiple directions, their legs and long winter coats appearing as dark silhouettes against the glowing pavement. They carry an assortment of umbrellas—many clear vinyl, some solid black and deep blue—which gleam with tiny, sharply defined water droplets. In the extreme foreground, out-of-focus pedestrians briefly cross the lens, creating fleeting, blurred shapes. Through the center of the rain-swept intersection, a massive, bright red double-decker bus enters from the right side of the frame and moves slowly horizontally toward the left. Its interior lights cast a warm yellow glow through the large rectangular side windows. As the bus rolls forward, its large black tires kick up a fine mist from the flooded road. One pedestrian in a tan trench coat abruptly tilts their clear umbrella forward to shield their face against the falling rain, while the sweeping, bright white headlights of off-screen traffic momentarily illuminate the slick asphalt behind the bus.
overall_soundscape: A continuous, heavy downpour of rain splashing loudly against the asphalt and pattering onto plastic umbrellas dominates the foreground. A pronounced, wet tire hiss and a deep, low-frequency engine rumble are clearly heard as the large red bus rolls across the scene. Underneath these primary sounds, a muffled layer of hurried, wet footsteps splashing through puddles blends seamlessly with the faint, distant hum of city traffic and subtle pedestrian rustling.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

intent: 3D武侠动画：屋顶追逐，壮汉挥杖砸瓦，戴斗笠的身影飞身踢开兵器，日落金光。
local:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D武侠动画风格，高角度俯瞰视角展现连绵的古建筑屋顶，深灰色瓦片在落日金光下呈现斑驳质感。身材魁梧的壮汉身穿深色粗布劲装，双手紧握暗铁长杖，重心下沉，发出一声低吼，挥动长杖重重砸向脚下瓦片。青瓦瞬间粉碎，碎片四溅，尘土在逆光中化作金色颗粒飞扬。 [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a low-angle dynamic tracking shot along the roof ridge. A figure wearing a bamboo hat leaps from the right, body agile and light. As the figure rotates in mid-air, they kick the end of the iron staff (兵器) with high speed. A sharp metallic clash rings out, the staff is deflected, and the burly man stumbles backward as broken tiles slide down the slope. [Shot 3] At 00:03.500, the camera pulls back slowly to show the standoff. The burly man regains his balance, gripping the staff with the tip striking the roof. The figure in the bamboo hat lands lightly in a half-squat, their silhouette outlined by the golden sunset light as their robes flutter in the wind.

overall_soundscape: The heavy thud of the staff smashing tiles is followed by the sharp, ringing impact of metal against metal. The sound of sliding debris and crumbling tiles persists, accompanied by the low, steady breathing of the combatants and the whistling of the wind across the rooftops.

non_diegetic_music: A dramatic, rhythmic percussion score featuring deep taiko drums and a sharp, high-pitched erhu melody that emphasizes the tension of the martial arts confrontation.
official:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D-animated, wide tracking shot from a low angle as the camera tracks right, following a muscular, burly man running across a slanted roof made of overlapping grey clay tiles. He wears rough crimson and brown martial arts robes with his thick forearms exposed, his heavy brow furrowed in a scowl. The scene is bathed in intense golden-hour light from a setting sun in the deep background, casting long, dramatic shadows across the traditional Chinese architecture. The burly man raises a heavy, iron-banded wooden staff high above his head and violently swings it downward, smashing directly into the roof tiles in the foreground. Debris and shattered clay pieces explode upward into the warm, glowing air as his shoulders heave from the sheer force of the impact. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera cuts to a medium wide shot, panning left to capture a new figure entering the frame. A lean martial artist wearing a wide-brimmed woven bamboo hat and flowing dark blue robes flies horizontally through the air from the right. The setting sun glows brilliantly behind the figure, creating a golden rim-light effect on the edges of the hat and fabric. The lean figure extends a cloth-wrapped leg in a dynamic flying kick, striking the upper shaft of the iron-banded wooden staff from Shot 1 just as the burly man attempts to recover his stance. The powerful strike violently deflects the weapon outward to the right, sending a spray of residual tile dust floating into the golden light while the burly man's arms jolt backward and his torso twists defensively from the sudden kinetic transfer.
overall_soundscape: The soundscape opens with the rapid, heavy clatter of boots crunching aggressively on clay roof tiles, mixed with the pronounced flapping of thick fabric in the wind. A deep, heavy whoosh of air is clearly heard, followed immediately by a loud, explosive crash as the wooden staff shatters the ceramic tiles, sending a distinct shower of sharp, clicking debris scattering across the roof. This transitions into a fast, slicing swoosh of airborne movement, culminating in a sharp, loud wooden thwack and a resonant metallic clang as the flying kick violently deflects the heavy staff.
non_diegetic_music: Fast-paced, high-energy traditional Chinese orchestral music, featuring driving heavy drums and a rapid, aggressive guzheng melody that maintains a relentless, driving tempo throughout the sequence.
